prompt: Use case: identity-preserve narrative restaging. First inputs canonical identity portraits; next room master is only architectural/palette reference; LAST input is prior scene for cast, approved face morphology and exact task content, NOT a pose to preserve. Preserve each canonical face, adult age, hair, eye/nose/jaw proportions and characteristic accessories. Farah lens anatomical LEFT eye; Demir comms anatomical RIGHT ear; Nazari and Mirza have no eyewear. Balanced stylized adult head/body scale, neither oversized heads nor realistic tiny heads. Clean cel-shaded adventure-comic linework, natural supported anatomy, two arms per character. Restage Demir seated at the bridge console turned fully toward his work, chair and torso naturally aligned to the angled main display. Camera looks diagonally across the console and catches his recognizable three-quarter face, eyes narrowed in concentration on the pending run. One hand types on the keyboard, other hovers naturally over the run control with a relaxed elbow supported by the desk. No camera gaze, no grin, no front-facing portrait. Main console has compact header Synthetic series, rows Rollout: prediction history and Replay: observed history. Below is an empty chart frame labeled Steps ahead horizontally and Scalar value vertically. Small legend Observed, Your rollout, Your replay. Center says Training pending. No curves, fabricated results or success checks. This is a real work interface oriented toward Demir; all typography, ticks and grid share its oblique plane. Other monitors and wrist screen off. Muted sage data, worn brass controls, charcoal room and natural warm skin. Head same balanced scale as reference, natural neck, two distinct shoulder-elbow-wrist chains and credible typing fingers. Output one full 1536x1024 scene. No text outside genuine work artifacts, no captions, no hero portraits, no camera-facing eye contact or lesson cards.
